## OhMyRotate
Smarter rotation, especially for video.

Take control of portrait and landscape rotation without constantly opening Control Center.

Automatically disable portrait lock for selected apps, unlock rotation during supported video playback, and keep videos landscape while you watch.

Completely free. Configure in Settings, with English and Vietnamese support.

Landscape hold uses an empty whitelist by default: select the apps you want it to apply to. Playback detection and fullscreen behavior depend on the app.

Release candidate: you may need to pause video before switching apps if landscape lock persists. iOS 15 is not supported.

views.title: Compatibility
views.text: iPhone, iOS 16-17. Rootless and RootHide. iOS 15 is not supported. Release candidate; RootHide device validation is pending.
